content: We need to count carbonyl groups in the molecule. But we don't have the molecule given. Possibly the system expects us to retrieve IR spectra or NMR to infer carbonyls. However simplest: we can request IR spectra which shows C=O stretch around 1700 cm-1. But we need count. Could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons ~190-210 ppm. But we need the molecule structure? Not provided. Maybe the environment has a sample "at hand". The tools operate on "sample at hand" without needing SMILES. So we can request carbon NMR spectra and count carbonyl signals. Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra.
